author: MrNuggly
body:
Hello,
My IGN is MrNuggly, and I was banned for flying.  I have never been banned before, and just downloaded a flying client, which I knew would work on this server because I have seen lots of players fly before.  I should not have flown, and I already removed the client from my laptop.  I am sorry, and won't ever use another client again.

Sincerely,
MrNuggly

title: MrNuggly Appeal

replies.author: MidnightBeats
replies.body: You were only banned recently and must wait longer to appeal a punishment for hacking. Please try again in the future.
